'''Medtech Industries''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company that was also a trailblazer in the medical field. They developed some of the earliest [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], including the [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droid]]. However, increased competition in the field, along with changing consumer tastes led the once successful company to not be able to produce any new models.<ref name="EGTD" />

Medtech relocated to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] before declaring bankruptcy shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="G3">{{GamerCite|3|Look Sir, Droids!}}</ref> The company apparently fell out of business by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], likely due to its primary line, the FX-series, becoming obsolete.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
